notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
With this new update 1.5, I've taken player feedback and incorporated some changes and tweaks to the game, as well as some bug fixes.
[list]
[*] The Xenolith now also slows time in addition to its previous function.
[*] Tweaked sanity details; sanity regenerates slightly faster for example.
[*] Reduced some enemy placements, especially around areas with key items
[*] Enemies no longer chase you as long as they used to.
[*] Fixed a bug causing enemies to move at full speed in water.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused finding Lorenzo to not register in your objectives as completed.
[*] Finding Lorenzo is now a checkpoint.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the xenolith's UI elements to sometimes not show correctly after respawning.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused objectives to not be registered correctly after respawning.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some items to remain in the world even after being picked up.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused checkpoints to not register correctly under specific conditions.
[*] Fixed typos and other miscellaneous mistakes.
[*] Tweaked audio glitches and/or bugs.
[/list]

Thanks guys!

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
This update fixes a lot of the bugs that weren't already fixed since release, including:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause some special items to continue scrolling dialogue infinitely, preventing the player from continuing
[*] Tweaked some of the UI menu screens to better fill the screen at various resolutions
[*] Fixed audio glitches involving some environmental and enemy sounds
[*] Fixed a bug that would prevent some items from displaying text properly
[*] Fixed a bug causing text to sometimes be cut short
[/list]

[u][b]UPCOMING CHANGES:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Design tweaks, such as how the xenolith functions
[*] More audio tweaks
[*] Alterations to some of the enemy behavior
[*] Fine tuning of sanity / xenolith balance
[/list]
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.content:
Releasing the game has uncovered some bugs/glitches etc that slipped through the cracks before, so I'm preparing a new update for the game to fix most of these. Today I fixed one relatively major bug:

[list]
[*] On some menu screens, the mouse would become locked in the center of the screen.
[/list]

There are still others, of course, so expect a new update in the next day or two. Thanks for the understanding! ːsteamhappyː
